blocks.text:
flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

2. AC1: every primary carries an id
3. AC2: step after primary is retry with: same pin, if contains `steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`, overwrite:true, name equal, **path equal**, **retention-days equal**
4. AC3: retry if contains always(), continue-on-error not true
5. scope: for these legs the scope/pending/dedupe gate lives at the JOB level — assert the job-level `if` carries `needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true'` (faui/flutter app+core+shared) — i.e. the retries inherit it.

flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

# pr-1725: gh-1724 [ci-red] v1.0.611 failed

## Description

Closes #1724
### Root Cause

CI run 39432336443 (tag v1.0.611) red'd `Core tests (shard 3/4)` with every shard test green: the `junit-shard-3` artifact upload died on a single transient GitHub blob-storage error (`Failed to FinalizeArtifact: (404) artifact not found`); the `Quality gate` then failed mechanically on `test-core = failure`. The `test-core` shard uploads (`coverage-shard-N`, `junit-shard-N`) are the only sharded evidence uploads without the gh-1412 one-shot retry that already protects the pty leg against this exact failure class.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`test-core` job): gave `coverage-shard-N` / `junit-shard-N` primaries step `id`s and added the gh-1412 companion retry after each — same pinned `upload-artifact@v7.0.2` line, `overwrite: true`, gated on `always() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`, same artifact name/path/retention, scope gate preserved.
- A transient finalize failure now gets exactly one more attempt; a genuinely dead endpoint still fails the shard loudly.

### Test Coverage

- `test/ci_core_shard_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` — new YAML-level guard mirroring `ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (RED before the fix: 3 failures; GREEN after).

- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 11379 passed, 11 skipped (platform-gated), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Verified transient, not product code: the sibling `release`-event run of the same tag (39432339703) is fully green including `junit-shard-3`.
- The ticket closes when the ref goes green; the retry prevents this failure class from re-red'ing future `v*` tag runs.

flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

# pr-1725: gh-1724 [ci-red] v1.0.611 failed

## Description

Closes #1724
### Root Cause

CI run 39432336443 (tag v1.0.611) red'd `Core tests (shard 3/4)` with every shard test green: the `junit-shard-3` artifact upload died on a single transient GitHub blob-storage error (`Failed to FinalizeArtifact: (404) artifact not found`); the `Quality gate` then failed mechanically on `test-core = failure`. The `test-core` shard uploads (`coverage-shard-N`, `junit-shard-N`) are the only sharded evidence uploads without the gh-1412 one-shot retry that already protects the pty leg against this exact failure class.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`test-core` job): gave `coverage-shard-N` / `junit-shard-N` primaries step `id`s and added the gh-1412 companion retry after each — same pinned `upload-artifact@v7.0.2` line, `overwrite: true`, gated on `always() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`, same artifact name/path/retention, scope gate preserved.
- A transient finalize failure now gets exactly one more attempt; a genuinely dead endpoint still fails the shard loudly.

### Test Coverage

- `test/ci_core_shard_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` — new YAML-level guard mirroring `ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (RED before the fix: 3 failures; GREEN after).
- Targeted guards green: `ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart`, `release_hygiene_test.dart` (62 tests passed).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 11379 passed, 11 skipped (platform-gated), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Verified transient, not product code: the sibling `release`-event run of the same tag (39432339703) is fully green including `junit-shard-3`.
- The ticket closes when the ref goes green; the retry prevents this failure class from re-red'ing future `v*` tag runs.

flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

# pr-1725: gh-1724 [ci-red] v1.0.611 failed

## Description

Closes #1724
### Root Cause

CI run 39432336443 (tag v1.0.611) red'd `Core tests (shard 3/4)` with every shard test green: the `junit-shard-3` artifact upload died on a single transient GitHub blob-storage error (`Failed to FinalizeArtifact: (404) artifact not found`); the `Quality gate` then failed mechanically on `test-core = failure`. The `test-core` shard uploads (`coverage-shard-N`, `junit-shard-N`) are the only sharded evidence uploads without the gh-1412 one-shot retry that already protects the pty leg against this exact failure class.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`test-core` job): gave `coverage-shard-N` / `junit-shard-N` primaries step `id`s and added the gh-1412 companion retry after each — same pinned `upload-artifact@v7.0.2` line, `overwrite: true`, gated on `always() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`, same artifact name/path/retention, scope gate preserved.
- A transient finalize failure now gets exactly one more attempt; a genuinely dead endpoint still fails the shard loudly.

### Test Coverage

- `test/ci_core_shard_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` — new YAML-level guard mirroring `ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (RED before the fix: 3 failures; GREEN after).

- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 11379 passed, 11 skipped (platform-gated), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Verified transient, not product code: the sibling `release`-event run of the same tag (39432339703) is fully green including `junit-shard-3`.
- The ticket closes when the ref goes green; the retry prevents this failure class from re-red'ing future `v*` tag runs.

Wait — one subtlety: in test-faui, is `always()` appropriate? The primaries don't have `if: always()`. The job: `flutter test` step runs (no always()), then uploads run only if the test step succeeded. If the test step fails, uploads are skipped → retry (outcome skipped ≠ failure) also skipped. So retries only matter when the upload itself failed. Good — `always() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`: always() makes the step reachable even if a *previous* step failed (e.g., the test step failed → but then the upload's outcome is 'skipped' → retry doesn't fire). flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

+// gh-1724 — the `test-core` shard jobs' artifact uploads ride the same
+// bounded one-shot retry the pty leg got in gh-1412.
+//
+// CI run 39432336443 (tag v1.0.611) red'd `Core tests (shard 3/4)` with
+// every shard test GREEN: the `junit-shard-3` upload died with
+// `Failed to FinalizeArtifact: Received non-retryable error: Failed
+// request: (404) Not Found: artifact not found` — one transient error on
+// GitHub's blob-storage finalize call failed the shard, the aggregate
+// Quality gate followed (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure
+// (test-core)`), and the whole release run went red. This is the same
+// failure class gh-1412 fixed for the pty-integration-linux leg (run
+// 37807820733, ECONNRESET at finalize, 68/68 tests green) — but the
+// `test-core` evidence uploads (`coverage-shard-N`, `junit-shard-N`)
+// never got the companion retry. The retry is the follow-up step
+// re-running the SAME pinned upload-artifact action: the failed attempt
+// leaves the artifact half-registered, so the retry must carry
+// `overwrite: true` (with the default `overwrite: false` the retry dies
+// on "already exists" and guards nothing); a genuinely dead endpoint
+// still fails the shard loudly.
+//
+// Deliberately YAML-level asserts (the ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart
+// / ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart static pattern):
+//  AC1  every primary upload-artifact step in `test-core` carries an `id`
+//       — the retry references it,
+//  AC2  each primary upload is followed by a retry step running the SAME
+//       digest pin with `overwrite: true` and the same artifact name,
+//       gated on `steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'` — a transient finalize
+//       failure gets one more attempt, a real failure still reds the
+//       shard loudly,
+//  AC3  the retries stay `always()`-reachable (the uploads exist so the
+//       coverage merge and the weekly rebalancer keep their evidence; a
+//       retry keyed without `always()` would be skipped outright after a
+//       failed step) and never `continue-on-error` (a dead blob endpoint
+//       must still fail the shard — the coverage gate merges these
+//       lcovs).
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:test/test.dart';
+import 'package:yaml/yaml.dart';
+
+String read(String path) => File(path).readAsStringSync();
+
+const ci = '.github/workflows/ci.yml';
+const coreJobId = 'test-core';
+
+/// The digest pin every upload-artifact step (retry included) must carry —
+/// the same line test/release_hygiene_test.dart pins repo-wide (gh-995:
+/// the gate's download-artifact digest-validates every download).
+const artifactPin =
+    'actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9';
+
+bool isUploadStep(YamlMap step) =>
+    (step['uses']?.toString() ?? '').startsWith('actions/upload-artifact@');
+

      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)

Now I have the full picture. The pty pattern: retry `if: always() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`.

For test-faui (job-level `if` gates scope/pending/dedupe), the retries should be:
```yaml
     - name: Retry coverage upload (transient blob-storage reset, gh-1412)
       uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
       if: always() && steps.upload_faui_coverage.outcome == 'failure'
       with:
         name: faui-coverage-shard-${ matrix.shard }}
         path: packages/fa_ui/coverage/lcov.info
         retention-days: 2
         overwrite: true
``

Wait — one subtlety: in test-faui, is `always()` appropriate? The primaries don't have `if: always()`. The job: `flutter test` step runs (no always()), then uploads run only if the test step succeeded. If the test step fails, uploads are skipped → retry (outcome skipped ≠ failure) also skipped. So retries only matter when the upload itself failed. Good — `always() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`: always() makes the step reachable even if a *previous* step failed (e.g., the test step failed → but then the upload's outcome is 'skipped' → retry doesn't fire). Good.

Now — the review comment also notes: "Note (pre-existing, out of diff): unlike the pty leg (#928), test-core's primaries lack `if: always()`, so a red shard still loses its coverage/junit evidence; the new retries correctly fire only on *failed* uploads, not skipped ones." — that's marked as pre-existing note, not a request. Leave as-is (out of diff, would change behavior of evidence-on-red-legs — a separate decision; the reviewer didn't ask for it in Next Steps).

``

flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

      - name: Assert shard manifest (union/disjoint/no-goldens)

          python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py

      - run: cd packages/fa_ui && flutter pub get

      # shard_files.py bin-packs uncovered files into shards at runtime;
      # the weekly rebalance then absorbs them into the manifest.

      # attempt leaves the artifact half-registered — without overwrite the

flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.

test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]

    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # full non-golden suite, pairwise disjoint, ZERO golden leakage —
      # fails loudly on manifest drift or a golden-pattern rename before
      # any test runs. Pure python, no flutter needed.
      - name: Assert shard manifest (union/disjoint/no-goldens)
        working-directory: packages/fa_ui
        run: >-
          python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py
          ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

      - run: cd packages/fa_ui && flutter pub get

      # E2: a NEW test file added by a PR needs no manifest edit —
      # shard_files.py bin-packs uncovered files into shards at runtime;
      # the weekly rebalance then absorbs them into the manifest.
      - name: flutter test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        working-directory: packages/fa_ui

            test-results/junit-faui-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

The job: `flutter test` step runs (no always()), then uploads run only if the test step succeeded. If the test step fails, uploads are skipped → retry (outcome skipped ≠ failure) also skipped. So retries only matter when the upload itself failed. blocks.text:
flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # Shard-manifest assert (AC1/E4): union of the 3 selections == the
      # full non-golden suite, pairwise disjoint, ZERO golden leakage —
      # fails loudly on manifest drift or a golden-pattern rename before
      # any test runs. Pure python, no flutter needed.
      - name: Assert shard manifest (union/disjoint/no-goldens)
        working-directory: packages/fa_ui
        run: >-
          python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py
          ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

      - run: cd packages/fa_ui && flutter pub get

      # E2: a NEW test file added by a PR needs no manifest edit —
      # shard_files.py bin-packs uncovered files into shards at runtime;
      # the weekly rebalance then absorbs them into the manifest.
      - name: flutter test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        working-directory: packages/fa_ui
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 ../../scripts/shard_files.py \
            ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }} --exclude golden)
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/flutter-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 ../../scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/flutter-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-faui-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: faui-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: packages/fa_ui/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # junit durations for the weekly shard-rebalance.yml (AC3), same
      # contract as the core shards.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: junit-faui-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: packages/fa_ui/test-results/junit-faui-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7

  # E3/AC6: the 3 shard reports merge into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never
  # cat — no triple-counting). fa_ui coverage is NOT fed into the 80%
  # ratchet: the coverage gate's semantics stay exactly as before; this
  # merged report is telemetry/evidence only.
  faui-coverage:
    name: fa_ui coverage merge (one report)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes, test-faui]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage
          test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart
          test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      # gh-1724: the shard evidence uploads ride the gh-1412 one-shot retry —
      # run 39432336443 (tag v1.0.611) red'd shard 3 with every test GREEN on
      # a single transient `Failed to FinalizeArtifact: 404 artifact not
      # found` from GitHub's blob storage; the Quality gate followed
      # (`a leg is failure (test-core)`) and the release went red. Same
      # shape as the pty leg: the retry re-runs the SAME pinned action with
      # overwrite:true (a failed attempt leaves the artifact half-registered
      # — without overwrite the retry dies on "already exists"); a genuinely
      # dead endpoint still fails the shard loudly.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        id: upload_core_coverage
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2
      - name: Retry coverage upload (transient blob-storage reset, gh-1412)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: >-
          always() && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
          && steps.upload_core_coverage.outcome == 'failure'
        with:
          name: coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2
          overwrite: true

      # junit durations for the weekly shard-rebalance.yml (retention 7d so
      # a quiet week never starves it into the file-count fallback).
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        id: upload_core_junit
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retry junit upload (transient blob-storage reset, gh-1412)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: >-
          always() && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
          && steps.upload_core_junit.outcome == 'failure'
        with:
          name: junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

      # Upload MUST stay on the current upload-artifact line (gh-995): the
      # gate's download-artifact v8 digest-validates every download, so an
      # old-line upload digest-mismatches and the shard merge loses its
      # report (test/release_hygiene_test.dart pins the pin).
      #
      # gh-1412: each evidence upload carries a one-shot retry (the step
      # right after it, same pinned action). The gh-1412 validation run
      # 37807820733 red'd a shard whose 68 tests ALL passed on a single
      # transient `Failed to FinalizeArtifact: ECONNRESET` from GitHub's
      # blob storage — the aggregate gate followed and the merge aborted.
      # The retry re-runs the SAME action with overwrite:true (a failed
      # attempt leaves the artifact half-registered — without overwrite the
      # retry dies on "already exists"); a genuinely dead endpoint still
      # fails the shard loudly, and the retries stay if: always()-reachable
      # so red legs keep their evidence. Guarded by
      # test/ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        id: upload_integration_json
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
          retention-days: 2
      - name: Retry integration-json upload (transient blob-storage reset, gh-1412)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always() && steps.upload_integration_json.outcome == 'failure'
        with:

          path: test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
          retention-days: 2
          overwrite: true

        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/junit-integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retry junit upload (transient blob-storage reset, gh-1412)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2

        with:

          path: test-results/junit-integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

Wait — one subtlety: in test-faui, is `always()` appropriate? The primaries don't have `if: always()`. The job: `flutter test` step runs (no always()), then uploads run only if the test step succeeded. If the test step fails, uploads are skipped → retry (outcome skipped ≠ failure) also skipped. So retries only matter when the upload itself failed. Good — `always() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'failure'`: always() makes the step reachable even if a *previous* step failed (e.g., the test step failed → but then the upload's outcome is 'skipped' → retry doesn't fire). flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache

          BASE_URL=

      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by

      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)

            echo "::endgroup::"

test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # Shard-manifest assert (AC1/E4): union of the 3 selections == the
      # full non-golden suite, pairwise disjoint, ZERO golden leakage —
      # fails loudly on manifest drift or a golden-pattern rename before
      # any test runs. Pure python, no flutter needed.
      - name: Assert shard manifest (union/disjoint/no-goldens)
        working-directory: packages/fa_ui
        run: >-
          python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py
          ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

      - run: cd packages/fa_ui && flutter pub get

      # E2: a NEW test file added by a PR needs no manifest edit —
      # shard_files.py bin-packs uncovered files into shards at runtime;
      # the weekly rebalance then absorbs them into the manifest.
      - name: flutter test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        working-directory: packages/fa_ui
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 ../../scripts/shard_files.py \
            ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }} --exclude golden)
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/flutter-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 ../../scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/flutter-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-faui-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: faui-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: packages/fa_ui/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # junit durations for the weekly shard-rebalance.yml (AC3), same
      # contract as the core shards.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: junit-faui-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: packages/fa_ui/test-results/junit-faui-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7

  # E3/AC6: the 3 shard reports merge into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never
  # cat — no triple-counting). fa_ui coverage is NOT fed into the 80%
  # ratchet: the coverage gate's semantics stay exactly as before; this
  # merged report is telemetry/evidence only.

blocks.text:
flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

      - name: Format coverage to lcov

          always() && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

        with:
          name: coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2
          overwrite: true
